title: Ka ʻai a me ke kūʻai ʻana
description: Ten short stories about food and shopping in Hawaiʻi: a grandmother's cooking, a store without power, a bag law, fishing, fruit trees, the market year, food history, a church meal, a cooking class and a fair.

lessons.title: Ka ʻai a ke kupuna
lessons.summary: Lehua and her mother visit her grandmother, who has cooked far too much food for the three of them.
lessons.text:
He kaikamahine ʻo Lehua. Noho ʻo ia me kona makuahine, ʻo Kēhaulani, ma Waimānalo. Noho ko Lehua kupuna, ʻo Iwalani, ma kekahi hale liʻiliʻi ma Waimānalo nō. Maikaʻi loa ka ʻai a ke kupuna.

Nehinei, ua hele ke kaikamahine me kona makuahine i ka hale o ke kupuna. Ua hana ʻo Iwalani i ka ʻai no lāua. Nui loa ka ʻai!

"Ua ʻai ʻolua i kēia lā?" wahi a ke kupuna. "ʻAʻole," wahi a Lehua. "ʻAʻole au i ʻai." "He ʻai kēia no ʻolua," wahi a Iwalani. "ʻEhia kānaka e ʻai ana?" wahi a Lehua. "ʻEkolu wale nō," wahi a kona makuahine. "Nui loa ka ʻai no ʻekolu kānaka!" "ʻAe," wahi a ke kupuna, "akā makemake au i ka ʻai nui."

Ua ʻai lākou a pau. Ua lawe mai ke kupuna i ka wai no ke kaikamahine a me kona makuahine. Ma hope, ua piha ka ʻōpū o Lehua. "Ua piha ʻoe?" wahi a ke kupuna. "ʻAe, ua piha loa," wahi a Lehua.

Nā nīnau:
Ua hele ʻo Lehua me wai nehinei?
Nehinei, ua hele ʻo ia me kona makuahine i ka hale o ke kupuna.
ʻEhia kānaka i ʻai?
ʻEkolu kānaka i ʻai.
Ua lawe mai ke kupuna i ka wai?
ʻAe, ua lawe mai ʻo ia i ka wai.
Ua piha ka ʻōpū o Lehua ma hope?
ʻAe, ua piha loa ka ʻōpū o Lehua.

lessons.title: ʻAʻole hana ka uila
lessons.summary: The power goes out at a food store in Kaunakakai, so Kekai writes every sale on paper until the computer works again.
lessons.text:
Hana ʻo Kekai ma kekahi hale kūʻai ʻai ma Kaunakakai. Aia ka luna o ka hale kūʻai, ʻo Kahele, i loko o kona keʻena.

Hoʻohana ka hale kūʻai i kekahi ʻōnaehana kamepiula. Mālama ka ʻōnaehana i ka ʻikepili o ka hale kūʻai: ka ʻai a me ke kālā. Hoʻohana ʻo Kekai i kekahi mīkini liʻiliʻi e helu i ke kālā.

I kēia lā, ʻaʻole hana ka uila. Ua kū ka mīkini, a ua kū pū ka ʻōnaehana. Ua haʻalele ʻo Kahele i kona keʻena. "ʻAʻole hana ka uila ʻānō," wahi āna. "ʻAʻole hiki i ka kamepiula ke mālama i ka ʻikepili ʻānō."

Ua kū nā kānaka ma waho o ka hale kūʻai. Ua lawe ʻo Kekai i kekahi palapala. Ua kākau ʻo ia i ka ʻai a me ke kālā o kēlā me kēia kanaka ma ka palapala. Ua haʻalele nā kānaka me kā lākou ʻai.

Ma hope, ua hana hou ka uila. Ua kākau ʻo Kekai i ka ʻikepili o ka palapala ma ka kamepiula. "Maikaʻi loa kēia," wahi a Kahele.

Nā nīnau:
Ua kū nā kānaka ma waho o ka hale kūʻai?
ʻAe, ua kū lākou ma waho.
Ua hana ka uila i kēia lā?
ʻAʻole, ʻaʻole i hana ka uila.
Ua kākau ʻo Kekai ma ka kamepiula?
ʻAʻole, ua kākau ʻo ia ma kekahi palapala.
Ma hope, ua hana hou ka uila?
ʻAe, ua hana hou ka uila.

lessons.title: Ke kānāwai hou
lessons.summary: A new law stops shops on Kauaʻi from giving out bags; Keawe is against it at first, but later he brings his own.
lessons.text:
Hana ʻo Hiʻilei ma kona hale kūʻai liʻiliʻi ma Līhuʻe. I kēia makahiki, ua hoʻomaka kekahi kānāwai hou ma Kauaʻi: ʻaʻole hiki i nā hale kūʻai ke hāʻawi i nā ʻeke.

He kuleana ko Hiʻilei: hoʻokō ʻo ia i ke kānāwai. Ua kākau ʻo ia i kekahi hōʻailona: "He kānāwai hou kēia." Aia ka hōʻailona ma ka puka.

I kekahi lā, ua kūʻai ʻo Keawe i ka ʻai he nui, akā ʻaʻole ʻo ia i lawe mai i kekahi ʻeke. "Kūʻē au i kēia kānāwai," wahi a Keawe. "ʻAʻole kūpono kēia kānāwai."

ʻOkoʻa ka manaʻo o Hiʻilei. Manaʻo ʻo ia he kānāwai kūpono kēia no ka ʻāina a me ke kai. Ua hāʻawi ʻo ia i kekahi pahu kahiko iā Keawe no kāna ʻai.

Ua noʻonoʻo ʻo Keawe i ke kānāwai. Ma hope, ua hoʻomau ʻo ia i ke kūʻai ʻana ma laila, akā ua ʻokoʻa kona manaʻo: lawe mai ʻo ia i kāna ʻeke.

Nā nīnau:
Ua hoʻokō ʻo Hiʻilei i ke kānāwai hou?
ʻAe, he kuleana ko Hiʻilei: hoʻokō ʻo ia i ke kānāwai.
Kūʻē ʻo Keawe i ke kānāwai?
ʻAe, kūʻē ʻo ia i ke kānāwai.
Ua noʻonoʻo ʻo Keawe i ke kānāwai?
ʻAe, ua noʻonoʻo ʻo ia i ke kānāwai.
Ua hoʻomau ʻo Keawe i ke kūʻai ʻana ma laila?
ʻAe, ua hoʻomau ʻo ia, a lawe mai ʻo ia i kāna ʻeke.

lessons.title: Ma ka moana
lessons.summary: Kealiʻi and his son sail east before daylight, find fish under the birds, catch one as long as the boy and sell it in Lāhainā.
lessons.text:
Noho ʻo Kealiʻi ma Lāhainā. Hana ʻo ia ma ka moana: hoʻi mai ʻo ia me ka iʻa, a kūʻai aku ʻo ia i ka iʻa. He moku liʻiliʻi kona.

I kekahi lā, ua hele ʻo Kealiʻi me kāna keiki, ʻo Kaʻimi, i ka moana ma mua o ke ao. Nui nā hōkū ma luna. Ua nānā ʻo Kaʻimi i nā hōkū. Ua holo ka moku i ka hikina. Ma ka hikina, ua puka mai ke ao.

Ma ka moana, ua ʻike lāua i nā manu ma luna o ke kai. "Aia ka iʻa ma lalo o nā manu," wahi a Kealiʻi. Ua holo ka moku i nā manu.

Ua loaʻa iā lāua kekahi iʻa lōʻihi. Ikaika loa ia! Ikaika pū ʻo Kaʻimi, a ua kōkua ʻo ia i kona makuakāne. Ua like ka lōʻihi o ka iʻa me ka lōʻihi o Kaʻimi.

Ma hope, ua holo ka moku i Lāhainā. Ua hoʻopaʻa ʻo Kaʻimi i ka moku,. Ua kūʻai mai kekahi wahine i ka iʻa lōʻihi.

Nā nīnau:
Ua hele ʻo Kealiʻi me wai i ka moana?
Ua hele ʻo ia me kāna keiki, ʻo Kaʻimi.
Ua holo ka moku i ke komohana?
ʻAʻole, ua holo ka moku i ka hikina.
Ikaika ka iʻa?
ʻAe, ikaika loa ka iʻa, akā ikaika pū ʻo Kaʻimi.
Ua hoʻopaʻa ʻo Kaʻimi i ka moku?
ʻAe, ua hoʻopaʻa ʻo ia i ka moku ma Lāhainā.

lessons.title: Ka lāʻau kahiko
lessons.summary: Kamalu and his daughter pick fruit from an old tree in Makawao, share half and plant a seed for a new tree.
lessons.text:
Aia kekahi lāʻau kahiko ma ka ʻāina o Kamalu ma Makawao. Lōʻihi nā lālā o ka lāʻau, a ulu nā hua he nui ma nā lālā. Noho kekahi moʻo ma luna o kekahi lālā.

Ua hele mai kāna kaikamahine, ʻo Kuʻulei. Ua lawe lāua i nā hua mai nā lālā. Paʻa kekahi mau hua. ʻAʻole maikaʻi nā hua paʻa no ka ʻai ʻānō. Ua kau ʻo Kuʻulei i nā hua paʻa ma luna o ka papa.

Ua hāʻawi lāua i ka hapa o nā hua i kekahi ʻohana ʻē aʻe.

"Makemake au i kekahi lāʻau hou," wahi a Kamalu. Ua hana lāua i kekahi lua ma ka honua. Ua hoʻokomo ʻo Kuʻulei i kekahi hua i loko o ka lua. Ua kau ʻo Kamalu i kekahi pale ma luna o ka lua. Pale ia i ka lā. "E ulu ana kēia lāʻau a nui, e like me ka lāʻau kahiko," wahi a Kamalu.

Nā nīnau:
Aia ka moʻo ma luna o ka lālā?
ʻAe, noho ka moʻo ma luna o kekahi lālā.
Maikaʻi nā hua paʻa no ka ʻai?
ʻAʻole, ʻaʻole maikaʻi nā hua paʻa no ka ʻai ʻānō.
Ua hāʻawi lāua i ka hapa o nā hua i kekahi ʻohana ʻē aʻe?
ʻAe, ua hāʻawi lāua i ka hapa o nā hua.
Ua hoʻokomo ʻo Kuʻulei i ka hua i loko o ka lua?
ʻAe, ua hoʻokomo ʻo ia i ka hua i loko o ka lua.

lessons.title: Nā mahina ma ka mākeke
lessons.summary: Laʻakea sells something different from his land in Pāhoa at the market in different months of the year.
lessons.text:
Hana ʻo Laʻakea ma kona ʻāina ma Pāhoa. Ulu nā mea ʻai like ʻole ma kona ʻāina. I kēlā me kēia mahina, kūʻai aku ʻo ia i kāna ʻai ma ka mākeke o Pāhoa. ʻOkoʻa ka ʻai i kēlā me kēia mahina.

Ma Pepeluali a me Malaki, kūʻai aku ʻo Laʻakea i ke kalo. Ma ʻApelila, Mei a me Iune, kūʻai aku ʻo ia i ka maiʻa. Ma Iulai, ʻAukake a me Kepakemapa, kūʻai aku ʻo ia i ka ʻulu. Ma Nowemapa a me Kekemapa, kūʻai aku ʻo ia i ka ʻalani.

I kekahi lā ma Iune, komo mai kekahi wahine. "ʻEhia mahina o ka ʻulu?" wahi āna. "ʻEkolu mahina," wahi a Laʻakea. "ʻAʻole i hiki mai ka manawa o ka ʻulu, akā he maiʻa maikaʻi kēia." Ua kūʻai ka wahine i ka maiʻa, a ua hoʻi mai ʻo ia ma Iulai no ka ʻulu.

Nā nīnau:
Kūʻai aku ʻo Laʻakea i ke kalo ma Pepeluali a me Malaki?
ʻAe, ma kēlā mau mahina ʻelua.
Kūʻai aku ʻo ia i ka maiʻa ma ʻApelila, Mei a me Iune?
ʻAe, ma kēlā mau mahina ʻekolu.
ʻEhia mahina o ka ʻulu?
ʻEkolu mahina: ʻo Iulai, ʻo ʻAukake a me Kepakemapa.
Kūʻai aku ʻo ia ma Nowemapa a me Kekemapa?
ʻAe, kūʻai aku ʻo ia i ka ʻalani ma kēlā mau mahina.

lessons.title: Ka mōʻaukala o ka ʻai
lessons.summary: Kamuela and his daughter visit an exhibition in Honolulu about the history of food in Hawaiʻi, room by room.
lessons.text:
Ua hele ʻo Kamuela me kāna kaikamahine, ʻo Kalei, i Honolulu. ʻO Honolulu ke kapikala o Hawaiʻi. Aia ma ke kapikala kekahi hōʻikeʻike no ka mōʻaukala o ka ʻai.

He ʻehā keʻena o ka hōʻikeʻike. Ma ke keʻena mua, ua aʻo lāua no ka wā kahiko. Ua ʻai ka lāhui Hawaiʻi i ke kalo a me ka iʻa. Ua hana kēlā me kēia ʻohana i kāna ʻai ponoʻī.

Ma ke keʻena ʻelua, ua aʻo lāua no ke kenekulia 19. Ma kēia kenekulia, ua liʻiliʻi ka heluna o ka lāhui Hawaiʻi, a ua nui ka heluna o nā kānaka mai nā ʻāina ʻē. Ua lawe mai lākou i nā ʻai hou. Ma ke keʻena ʻekolu, ua aʻo lāua no ke kenekulia 20.

Ma ke keʻena ʻehā, he ʻelima kiʻi o ka ʻai o kēia wā. Ua nānā ʻo Kalei i nā kiʻi ʻelima. Ua hoʻonui ʻo ia i kekahi kiʻi ma ka kamepiula.

Nā nīnau:
ʻEhia keʻena o ka hōʻikeʻike?
He ʻehā keʻena o ka hōʻikeʻike.
Ua hana kēlā me kēia ʻohana i kāna ʻai ponoʻī ma ka wā kahiko?
ʻAe, ua hana kēlā me kēia ʻohana i kāna ʻai ponoʻī.
Ma ke kenekulia 19, ua nui ka heluna o ka lāhui Hawaiʻi?
ʻAʻole, ua liʻiliʻi ka heluna.
Ua hoʻonui ʻo Kalei i kekahi kiʻi ma ka kamepiula?
ʻAe, ua hoʻonui ʻo ia i kekahi kiʻi.
He hōʻikeʻike ia no ka mōʻaukala o ka ʻai?
ʻAe, he hōʻikeʻike no ka mōʻaukala o ka ʻai.

lessons.title: Ka ʻai ma ka hale pule
lessons.summary: After the service at a church in Hanalei, the families put their food together, and Kaleikini finds that the best dish is her friend's.
lessons.text:
Hele ʻo Kaleikini i ka hale pule ma Hanalei me kona hoaaloha, ʻo Keʻalohi. Ma laila, hoʻomana nā kānaka i ke Akua. Pule lākou i ke Akua, a mele lākou me ka leo nui. Maikaʻi loa ka leo o Keʻalohi.

Ma hope o ka pule, ʻai pū nā kānaka a pau. Ua lawe mai kēlā me kēia ʻohana i kekahi ʻai. Ua hoʻohui lākou i ka ʻai a pau ma kekahi papa lōʻihi. Ua noho iho ʻo Kaleikini me kona mau hoa o ka hale pule, a ua ʻai iho lākou.

Maikaʻi loa kekahi ʻai. "Na wai kēia ʻai?" wahi a Kaleikini. "Na kou hoaaloha," wahi a kekahi wahine. "Nāna nō kēia ʻai." Ua hana ʻo Keʻalohi i ka ʻai ma kona hale. Nāna ka ʻai maikaʻi loa ma ka papa.

Maikaʻi ka pilina o nā hoa o ka hale pule. Hoʻohui lākou i kā lākou ʻai, a kōkua lākou kekahi i kekahi. He pilina maikaʻi pū ko Kaleikini me kona hoaaloha.

Nā nīnau:
Hele ʻo Kaleikini i ka hale pule me wai?
Hele ʻo ia me kona hoaaloha, ʻo Keʻalohi.
Hoʻomana nā kānaka i ke Akua ma ka hale pule?
ʻAe, hoʻomana lākou i ke Akua ma laila.
Ua hoʻohui lākou i ka ʻai ma ka papa lōʻihi?
ʻAe, ua hoʻohui lākou i ka ʻai a pau ma kekahi papa lōʻihi.
Na wai ka ʻai maikaʻi loa?
Na Keʻalohi; nāna ka ʻai maikaʻi loa.

lessons.title: Ka ʻai maikaʻi no ke kino
lessons.summary: Kaliko, a teacher with a university degree, teaches young students in Mililani to cook food that is good for the body.
lessons.text:
He kumu ʻo Kaliko ma kekahi kula ma Mililani. Loaʻa iā ia kekahi kēkelē mai ke kulanui ma Mānoa. Hoʻonaʻauao ʻo ia i nā ʻōpio no ka ʻai maikaʻi no ke kino.

I kēia lā, he 12 haumāna ma ka papa. Makemake nā haumāna e hana i kekahi ʻai hou. Ua kākau ʻo Kaliko i nā huaʻōlelo hou ma ka papa. Ua wehewehe ʻo ia i kēlā me kēia huaʻōlelo. "Maikaʻi kēia ʻai no ke kino," wahi āna. "He ʻai maikaʻi ia no nā ʻōpio."

Ua hana nā haumāna i ka ʻai. He haumāna noʻeau ʻo Kaʻena. Ua kōkua ʻo ia i nā haumāna ʻē aʻe, a ua wehewehe ʻo ia i ka hana iā lākou. "Noʻeau ʻoe," wahi a Kaliko. Ua hoʻonaʻauao ʻo Kaliko i ka papa holoʻokoʻa, akā ua aʻo nā haumāna kekahi i kekahi.

Ma hope, ua ʻai ka papa holoʻokoʻa i ka ʻai hou. Ua hoʻopau lākou i ka ʻai a pau. "Ua hoʻopau ʻoukou i ka ʻai!" wahi a Kaliko.

Nā nīnau:
He kumu ʻo Kaliko?
ʻAe, he kumu ʻo ia ma kekahi kula ma Mililani.
Loaʻa iā Kaliko kekahi kēkelē?
ʻAe, loaʻa iā ia kekahi kēkelē mai ke kulanui ma Mānoa.
ʻEhia haumāna ma ka papa?
He 12 haumāna ma ka papa.
Ua wehewehe ʻo Kaliko i nā huaʻōlelo hou?
ʻAe, ua wehewehe ʻo ia i kēlā me kēia huaʻōlelo.
Ua hoʻopau ka papa holoʻokoʻa i ka ʻai?
ʻAe, ua hoʻopau lākou i ka ʻai a pau.

lessons.title: He hanana kūikawā ma Waimea
lessons.summary: Akamu drives his two children to a special animal and food day in Waimea, and buys a koa-wood plate.
lessons.text:
Ua holo ʻo Akamu me kāna kamaliʻi, ʻo Kahala lāua ʻo Nāleʻa, ma ke kaʻa i Waimea. Lōʻihi ke ala, a ma ke ala, ua ʻike lākou i ka mauna nui. Ma Waimea, he hanana kūikawā i kēia lā: he lā no nā holoholona a me ka ʻai.

Ua piha ke kahua i ka lehulehu. Ua hele mai nā mākua me kā lākou kamaliʻi. Ua nānā nā kamaliʻi i nā holoholona o ka ʻāina. Nui nā holoholona, a nui pū ka ʻai kūikawā o Waimea. Ua ʻai lākou ma waena o ka lehulehu.

Ma kekahi wahi, ua kūʻai aku kekahi kāne i nā pā koa. Ua hana ʻo ia i nā pā mai ka lāʻau koa o ka mauna. Ua kūʻai ʻo Akamu i hoʻokahi pā koa no ka ʻai.

Ma hope, ua hoʻi lākou ma ke kaʻa ma ke ala lōʻihi. Ma ke kaʻa, ua noʻonoʻo nā kamaliʻi i nā holoholona. "He hanana maikaʻi loa kēia," wahi a Kahala.

Nā nīnau:
Ua holo ʻo Akamu i Waimea ma ke kaʻa?
ʻAe, ua holo ʻo ia me kāna kamaliʻi ma ke kaʻa.
Ua ʻike lākou i ka mauna ma ke ala?
ʻAe, ua ʻike lākou i ka mauna nui.
Ua hele mai nā mākua me kā lākou kamaliʻi?
ʻAe, ua piha ke kahua i ka lehulehu.
Ua kūʻai ʻo Akamu i kekahi pā koa?
ʻAe, ua kūʻai ʻo ia i hoʻokahi pā koa no ka ʻai.
